desc:
🤑 Steal Rare Items and Shatter Lucky Block Eggs And Defeat Boss!

How to Play:
🎃 Get past Patrols and defeat last boss
🧊 break the Lucky Blocks to collect rare Items, Animals, pets, dumplings, anomalies.
💰 Earn money from your Items, pets, dumplings, anomalies, brainrots.
⬆️ Upgrade your Pickaxes and base.
🏃 Rebirth and Buy more Speed and Jump.
🥷 Steal Rare Items from other players
✨ Discover rarer Items, pets, dumplings, Animals, Anomalies, Brainrots and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
